summary: Spec fidelity (checker.md 1.2.1 section 5, last sentence: 'The report lists the notRun commands, as it lists the prepare steps'): data has a top-level prepare member and no notRun member. The command ids appear only inside data.checks[].notRun of the checks that need `commands` (and L1.next), and in text mode as '(not run: dashboard)'. canon's L0 JSON report has data keys contractVersion, level, passed, prepare, checks: no notRun. A consumer that wants 'what did the fixture leave out' must union the per-check lists. Blast radius: every report of a fixture with notRun; no check result changes.
